IceServers.Name: ICE servers (JSON)
IceServers.Hint: STUN/TURN servers used for the audio connection, as a JSON array. Example with TURN: [{"urls":"stun:stun.l.google.com:19302"},{"urls":"turn:turn.example.com:3478","username":"user","credential":"pass"}]. Invalid values fall back to the default.
IceServers.ErrorShape: expected a non-empty array of objects with urls (text or list), and optional username and credential (text)
IceServers.ErrorScheme: every url must start with stun:, stuns:, turn: or turns:
IceServers.Fallback: Sargas Soundtrack: invalid ICE servers setting ({reason}). Using the default STUN server.

Bitrate.Name: Stream bitrate (kbps)
Bitrate.Hint: Opus bitrate of the music sent to each player, from 32 to 256. 128 is a good balance for stereo music; raise it for very rich music, lower it if a player's connection struggles. The GM row shows the measured bitrate and packet loss per player while live. A new bitrate applies to new connections: Stop and Go live again to apply it to everyone.

Checklist.Name: Setup checklist
Checklist.Label: Open checklist
Checklist.Hint: Checks the GM's browser and audio source, and lets you send a test tone to the players. Only the GM sees this.

Notify.SourceEnded: Sargas Soundtrack: the audio source ended, so the broadcast was stopped.

Error.insecure: Audio capture needs a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost).
Error.unsupported: This browser cannot capture audio this way.
Error.wrongSurface: Please share a browser tab (not a window or the whole screen) and tick "Also share tab audio".
Error.noAudio: No audio was shared. Tick "Also share tab audio" in the picker.
Error.cancelled: Audio capture was cancelled or not allowed.
Error.deviceMissing: The selected audio device was not found. Check that it is connected.
Error.needsClick: Tab capture must be started by clicking a button.
Error.failed: Audio capture failed. See the console for details.
Error.notActiveGM: Only the active GM can broadcast.
Error.notCapturing: Choose an audio source before going live.

Row.RefreshDevices: Refresh the list of audio devices (may briefly use the microphone)
Row.Meter: Level of the music being sent
Row.AudioLockedHint: Audio starts after you click anywhere in the window.

Secure.Title: Secure connection (HTTPS)
Secure.Pass: This page is served over HTTPS (or localhost), so audio capture is allowed.
Secure.Warn: This page is not in a secure context. Browsers block audio capture here. Open Foundry over HTTPS.

Browser.Title: Browser can capture tab audio
Browser.Pass: Chromium-based browser with tab capture available.
Browser.Firefox: Firefox cannot capture tab audio. Use Chrome or Edge on the GM's computer (or the Audio device source).
Browser.Other: This browser is not Chromium-based, so tab audio capture is unlikely to work. Use Chrome or Edge.
Browser.NoApi: This browser does not offer screen and tab capture (getDisplayMedia). Use the Audio device source or another browser.

Source.Title: Audio source
Source.Tab: Browser tab: the browser will ask you to pick a tab when you click Go live. Tick "Also share tab audio".
Source.DeviceNone: Audio device: no device chosen yet. Pick one in the sidebar row.
Source.DeviceUnchecked: Audio device chosen. Press the button to check that it still exists (this may briefly use the microphone).
Source.DeviceMissing: The saved audio device was not found. Check that it is connected and pick it again.
Source.DeviceError: Could not list the audio devices. Check the browser's microphone permission.

Headphones.Title: Headphones
Headphones.Detail: Wear headphones. Otherwise your speakers feed the music back into your microphone and Discord, and everyone hears an echo.

Tone.Title: Test tone
Tone.Detail: Sends a 10 second stereo tone (440 Hz left, 660 Hz right) to the players through their Music slider. If you were live, your source comes back afterwards.

Notes.Title: If players hear nothing or something odd
Notes.Muted: A muted browser or a muted tab captures silence. Unmute the music tab (and the browser) in Windows and in the browser.
Notes.VbDefaults: The VB-Cable installer makes CABLE the default Windows devices. Set your real speakers or headphones and microphone back as the Windows defaults.
Notes.Discord: In Discord keep input and output on "Default" or on your real devices, never on a CABLE device.
Notes.Routing: Send only your desktop music app to CABLE Input, in Windows "Volume mixer" or "App volume and device preferences".
